validity_failures: The execution stopped after 1475 of 1800 checkpointed assignments and produced no scheduled-summary.json.
Launch 1475 completed after the last durable checkpoint but belongs to an incomplete pairing key and is excluded from all reported metrics.
Validation outcomes have been inspected, so this tranche cannot be reused as an unopened confirmatory tranche.
diagnosis: The world-reference and orientation repair worked: the observed world build matches the freeze, and every graded C, D, and E trial contains at least one matched orientation.
The repaired Phoenix surface still underperforms B by 22.5 family-weighted percentage points; the complete-family sensitivity is minus 22.1 points.
C costs 4.03 times as much as B for equal assignments and about 8.79 times as much per observed success.
C reaches the turn limit in 73 of 295 trials. D and E reduce turn-limit failures but do not recover task success.
All arms score zero on absence and cascade, which requires a case, world, grader, and surface audit before attributing those failures only to Phoenix.
recommendation: Close Gate 1A, preserve this tranche as diagnostic evidence, improve the main protocol on authoring-only cases, independently review and refreeze any changed boundary, and use a new disjoint sealed validation tranche for any future gate attempt.
